title: skills-sh-jezweb-claude-skills-claude-agent-sdk
summary: # Changelog ## 0.3.301 - Added per-tool permission policies to sdk-type MCP server configs: `tools` entries with `permission_policy` `always_ask` or `always_deny`, applied on `initialize` and `setMcpServers()` - Added `BUILTIN_TOOL_NAMES` and `LEGACY_TOOL_NAME_ALIASES` exports: the public built-in tool names and their earlier names, for checking permission rules and tool settings - Added `addPlugins` to `Query.reloadPlugins()` so a host can load more plugin folders into a running session - Fixed `setModel()` with a model ID failing while the account is at its five-hour or weekly usage limit; the model now applies and the next message reports the limit - Changed the error when a full disk keeps the login from being refreshed: `error` is now `invalid_request`, not `authentication_failed`, and `api_error_status` is `null`, not 401 - Changed `mcpServerStatus()` to still report a tool's `_meta.ui.visibility` when the rest of its `_meta.ui` fails validation - Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.301 ## 0.3.300
type: skills
tags: skills-sh, skills-sh-all-time
source_url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anthropics/claude-agent-sdk-typescript/main/CHANGELOG.md
